events.title: I Added a Combo System to My Clicker Game
events.summary: Here’s a first look at the new Combo System in Evergreen Clicker! Keep clicking with the correct timing to build your combo, earn Good and Excellent ratings, and increase your click bonus. The longer you maintain the rhythm, the more powerful each click becomes—but miss the timing and the combo resets! This is still a work in progress, so the visuals, balancing, and effects may continue to improve. Wishlist Evergreen Clicker on Steam and follow the development! #EvergreenClicker #IndieGame #Clic

events.title: How Evergreen Clicker Started
events.summary: How it startedEvergreen Clicker started with one very rough drawing made in the middle of the night.I couldn’t sleep, so I sketched a simple idea: a tree in the centre, upgrades on the side, and a number that keeps growing when you click.It looked ugly. Very ugly. 😂But the basic idea stuck with me.I wanted to make an incremental game that felt peaceful instead of stressful. No armies, no endless killing, no dark apocalypse.
